description: Defines the TensorGeometry class and related functions for tensor shape and stride management in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: TensorGeometry
classes.description: Represents tensor shape, strides, and related properties, with methods for querying and manipulating tensor geometry.

methods.name: geometry_is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if tensor geometry specified by sizes and strides is contiguous.

methods.name: TensorGeometry
methods.description: Constructors for TensorGeometry, including default, from sizes, from TensorBase, and from explicit sizes, strides, and offset.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Returns whether the tensor geometry is contiguous.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns size of a specific dimension.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns all sizes as an array reference.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns stride of a specific dimension.

methods.name: strides
methods.description: Returns all strides as an array reference.

methods.name: storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the storage offset.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: sym_size
methods.description: Returns symbolic size of a dimension.

methods.name: sym_sizes
methods.description: Returns symbolic sizes.

methods.name: sym_stride
methods.description: Returns symbolic stride of a dimension.

methods.name: sym_strides
methods.description: Returns symbolic strides.

methods.name: sym_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns symbolic storage offset.

methods.name: sym_numel
methods.description: Returns symbolic number of elements.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Transposes two dimensions of the tensor geometry.

methods.name: mutable_sizes
methods.description: Returns mutable reference to sizes vector.

methods.name: mutable_strides
methods.description: Returns mutable reference to strides vector.

methods.name: mutable_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns mutable reference to storage offset.

methods.name: recompute
methods.description: Recomputes total number of elements after changes.
